CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.exam_x5ba53.m1_top_zips AS
WITH filtered AS (
 SELECT pickup_zip,
        COUNT(*) AS trips,
        SUM(fare_amount) AS total_fare
 FROM samples.nyctaxi.trips
 WHERE pickup_zip IS NOT NULL
 GROUP BY pickup_zip
 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 200
),
 total_rev AS (
 SELECT SUM(total_fare) AS grand_total FROM filtered
),
 ranked AS (
 SELECT f.*, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_fare DESC) AS fare_rank
 FROM filtered f
),
 cumulative AS (
 SELECT r.*, 
        ROUND((SUM(r.total_fare) OVER (ORDER BY r.total_fare DESC, r.pickup_zip ASC) / t.grand_total) * 100, 2) AS cumulative_share_pct
 FROM ranked r CROSS JOIN total_rev t
),
 busiest AS (
 SELECT pickup_zip,
        EXTRACT(HOUR FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt
 FROM samples.nyctaxi.trips
 WHERE pickup_zip IS NOT NULL
 GROUP BY pickup_zip, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM tpep_pickup_datetime)
 ),
 busiest_hour_per_zip AS (
 SELECT pickup_zip,
        MIN(hour) AS busiest_hour
 FROM (
   SELECT b.*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pickup_zip ORDER BY cnt DESC, hour ASC) AS rnk
   FROM busiest b
 ) sub
 WHERE rnk = 1
 GROUP BY pickup_zip
 )
SELECT c.pickup_zip,
       c.trips,
       ROUND(c.total_fare,2) AS total_fare,
       c.fare_rank,
       c.cumulative_share_pct,
       bh.busiest_hour
FROM cumulative c
JOIN busiest_hour_per_zip bh ON c.pickup_zip = bh.pickup_zip
WHERE c.fare_rank <= 10
ORDER BY c.fare_rank;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.exam_x5b44f.m1_top_zips AS
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT pickup_zip,
         COUNT(*) AS trips,
         SUM(fare_amount) AS total_fare
  FROM samples.nyctaxi.trips
  WHERE pickup_zip IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY pickup_zip
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 200
),
total_rev AS (
  SELECT SUM(total_fare) AS grand_total FROM filtered
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT f.*, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_fare DESC) AS fare_rank
  FROM filtered f
),
cumulative AS (
  SELECT r.*,
         ROUND((SUM(r.total_fare) OVER (ORDER BY r.total_fare DESC, r.pickup_zip ASC)
```sql
                / t.grand_total) * 100, 2) AS cumulative_share_pct
  FROM ranked r CROSS JOIN total_rev t
),
busiest AS (
  SELECT pickup_zip,
         EXTRACT(HOUR FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM samples.nyctaxi.trips
  WHERE pickup_zip IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY pickup_zip, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM tpep_pickup_datetime)
),
busiest_hour_per_zip AS (
  SELECT pickup_zip,
         MIN(hour) AS busiest_hour
  FROM (
    SELECT b.*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pickup_zip ORDER BY cnt DESC, hour ASC) AS rnk
    FROM busiest b
  ) sub
  WHERE rnk = 1
  GROUP BY pickup_zip
)
SELECT c.pickup_zip,
       c.trips,
       ROUND(c.total_fare, 2) AS total_fare,
       c.fare_rank,
       c.cumulative_share_pct,
       bh.busiest_hour
FROM cumulative c
JOIN busiest_hour_per_zip bh ON c.pickup_zip = bh.pickup_zip
WHERE c.fare_rank <= 10
ORDER BY c.fare_rank;
```
